method: Fixed scalar readout block sensitivity reparameterization; not HIG/SIP

synthetic_nonzero: initialpoint final-layerw replaced .01 normal(PRNGKey17), diagnostic only; never chooses factor
controls: Full output vector JVP vs centeredFD eps.003/.001/.0003 for first matched direction/head at both points; >=2of3relativevectorerrors<5%; metric identity; zerohead identity; helper parameter-map parity
compute: Single RTX5090 Slurm job, noDGX; source install/calibrationruntime recorded separately and must be accounted before equal-total-budget conclusions
